subtitle.zh: 一次动态图形设计尝试

text.zh:
《人民日报》“山水之间”论坛探讨如何让古典山水意境融入现代生活，以及如何在数字时代重构人与自然的哲学关系。

身处当代都市，一个值得深思的问题是：如何借助新兴数字媒介，让每个人都能抵达心之所向的山水天地？
text.en:
People’s Daily’s “Between Mountains and Waters” forum discusses how the classical “landscape mood” can appear in modern life and how the digital era might build a new nature philosophy.

In today’s urban life, a key question is: how can new digital media let everyone reach the mountain-and-water world they long for?

text.zh:
本项目旨在探寻“每个人心中的山水”。为此，我们首先了解不同个体对山水形态的认知与想象，再以极简的“一笔画”形式，引导参与者勾勒心中的山水意象。

研究对象涵盖风景园林专业的师生，以及非相关专业的学生，通过跨学科的对照研究，探索不同知识背景下山水认知与审美表达的异同。
text.en:
This project aims to find “the mountains-and- waters in each person’s heart.” To do that, we first learn how each user imagines landscape forms. Then, with a very simple method—“one-stroke drawing”—we let users express their own view of mountains and waters. 

Our study group includes landscape-architecture faculty and students, as well as students from non-landscape majors, so we can compare ideas across backgrounds.

text.zh:
通过前期用户调研，我们收集了大量山水轮廓图像，为后续数字生成艺术创作提供了丰富的素材。

参与者只需勾勒心中的山水轮廓，并提供一个专属幸运数字。其中，山水轮廓决定画面的形态构成，幸运数字则用于生成山峦与水体的色彩方案，使每幅作品都呈现出独特的视觉意境。
text.en:
After user surveys, numerous landscape outline images were collected, which can be used for subsequent digital generative art designs. Users are required to draw an outline and provide a lucky number. 

The outline serves as a reference for the image's form, while the lucky number is used to choose the color schemes for mountains and water bodies.

text.zh:
仅凭山水轮廓，尚不足以构筑完整的山水意境。色彩作为中国传统山水画的重要表现语言，承载着独特的审美意蕴与情感表达。

在数字媒介中，色彩通过 RGB、HSV 等数值模型加以呈现。因此，我们引入“幸运数字”作为色彩生成的依据，将个体的数字选择转化为独特的山水配色，赋予每幅作品个性化的视觉意境。
text.en: Using just the landscape outline to construct a landscape is insufficient, as color is a crucial element in Chinese landscape painting. In computers, colors are represented through RGB/HSV values, so users are asked to provide a lucky number for color generation.

bio.zh: 我叫吴浩，具有建筑学科背景，研究空间与叙事的有机关卡。探究不同的玩法，立足于系统理论，向外探索有趣的，实验性的玩法，目标是为爱好的玩家创造有趣的体验！
bio.en: My name is Hao Wu. With a background in architecture, I explore organic level design that seamlessly integrates space and narrative. Grounded in systems thinking, I experiment with innovative gameplay mechanics to create unique and engaging experiences for passionate players.
